defs.def: a part of the body that has a particular purpose, such as the heart or the brain; part of a plant with a particular purpose （人体或动植物的）器官

ex.s: Thankfully, the human brain is a complex organ.
To do CPR, you press on the sick person’s chest so that blood moves through the body and takes oxygen to organs.
ex.t: 运气站在他们这边；帕里斯的心跳恢复了。

ex.s: To give an example, I will be signing an organ donation agreement this time tomorrow.
ex.t: 举个例子，明天这个时候我将会签署一份器官捐献协议。

ex.s: Future continuous a … I will be signing an organ donation agreement this time tomorrow.
ex.t: 将来进行时 … 明天这个时候我将会签署一份器官捐献协议。

ex.s: Avoiding Exploring Overcoming Hesitating Of all the workings of the human body, there is one organ that produces the most intrigue amongst scientists.
ex.t: 回避 探索 克服 犹豫 在人体所有的工作原理中，有一个器官最能引起科学家的兴趣。

ex.s: Although the brain amounts to only about 2% of total body weight, it uses up to 20% of the body’s energy – more than any other organ.
ex.t: 虽然大脑仅占总体重的约2%，但它消耗了身体高达20%的能量——超过任何其他器官。

ex.s: Nevertheless, there is still a long way to go before we can completely understand the workings of this complex organ.
ex.t: 然而，在我们能够完全理解这个复杂器官的运作方式之前，还有很长的路要走。

defs.def: a large musical instrument with keys like a piano. Sounds are produced by air forced through pipes. 管风琴
a musical instrument similar to a pipe organ, but without pipes 风琴
an official organization that is part of a larger organization and has a special purpose （官方的）机构，机关
a newspaper or magazine that gives information about a particular group or organization; a means of communicating the views of a particular group 机关报刊；（某团体的）宣传工具
